set.body:
Objective

Make edge normalization, edge transformation, and partition reduction explicit ordered stages compiled into algebraically justified sufficient-statistic plans.

Primary ownership

Typed edge-operation/reducer values, R/compiler.R, R/task.R, R/kernel.R, memory planning, views, docs, and tests.

Deliverables

- inner_product(), covariance(), cosine(), and correlation() with declared variance policy.
- fisher_z() and rank_edges() with explicit boundary/tie policies.
- Default per-partition-edge normalize/transform then aggregate semantics.
- A distinctly named aggregate-first estimand if supported.
- Four lowering categories: bilinear, centered bilinear, normalized bilinear, and required-edge materialization.
- Sparse H support limits materialized numerator edges and required side statistics.
- Edge operation, transform, reducer, and order enter plan hashes and receipts.

Acceptance

Independent oracles cover every operation; tests prove correlation and Fisher do not commute with partition aggregation; sparse/dense H agree; zero variance, absolute correlation one, ties, missing/invalid policy inputs, and extreme scales have defined behavior; memory plans and benchmarks cover each lowering.

Non-goals

No generic engine registry and no implicit stage reordering.
set.title: Implement explicit edge operations and partition reducers
